# API and Patient-Data Requirements Checklist: Patient Registration and Profile Management

**Purpose**: Review the completeness, clarity, consistency, and traceability of patient-data security, privacy, API, and data-model requirements before PR approval.
**Created**: 2026-08-24
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md), [plan.md](../plan.md), [data-model.md](../data-model.md), [patient-api.md](../contracts/patient-api.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are authorized reception-staff actions and hospital-organization boundaries specified for registration, retrieval, search, and update? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, §FR-008–§FR-011]
- [ ] CHK002 Are all required, optional, and conditionally required patient fields defined consistently, including the complete emergency-contact rule? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004–§FR-007, Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK003 Does the specification define both patient identifiers, their uniqueness scope, and their immutability? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002–§FR-003, §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK004 Are data-retention, patient-deactivation, and record-correction boundaries intentionally excluded or explicitly specified for this feature? [Scope, Spec Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK005 Are actor identity, authorization ownership, and audit-event requirements documented as a trusted dependency rather than a request-supplied value? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015, Plan Constitution Check]

## API and Data-Model Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 Are the retrieval, search, registration, and update resource paths unambiguous and consistent with hospital scoping? [Clarity, Contract §§Register patient–Update basic information]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the required update concurrency token defined with its client-facing name, expected lifecycle, and stale-value handling? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014, Data Model Patient]
- [ ] CHK008 Are validation rules for date of birth, gender, email, mobile number, blank text, and partial emergency-contact data sufficiently specific to avoid conflicting interpretations? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, Data Model Patient]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the patient-number generation and display-format requirement sufficiently defined to preserve global uniqueness while remaining human-readable? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-003, Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK010 Are search matching semantics defined consistently for patient number, partial names, mobile numbers, casing, whitespace, ordering, and pagination? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009, Assumptions, Contract §Search patients]

## Consistency and Traceability

- [ ] CHK011 Are hospital-wide patient sharing and hospital-scoped access requirements consistent across the clarifications, functional requirements, data model, and API contract? [Consistency, Spec Clarifications, §FR-001, §FR-008–§FR-009]
- [ ] CHK012 Are patient-number uniqueness requirements consistent between the specification, plan summary, data model, and contract? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, Plan Summary, Data Model Patient]
- [ ] CHK013 Are the immutable patient attributes consistent between the update requirement, data-model invariants, and update contract? [Consistency, Spec §FR-012, Data Model Invariants, Contract §Update basic information]
- [ ] CHK014 Do audit requirements consistently identify actions, target, hospital, trusted actor, timestamp, and PII-free metadata? [Consistency, Spec §FR-015, Data Model Audit Event]
- [ ] CHK015 Are each of the API contract error outcomes traceable to a functional requirement or documented edge case? [Traceability, Spec §FR-007, §FR-013–§FR-014, Edge Cases, Contract]

## Security and Privacy Coverage

- [ ] CHK016 Are authorization requirements defined for every patient-data operation, including cross-hospital access attempts and patient-number lookup? [Coverage, Spec §FR-001, §FR-008–§FR-011, Contract]
- [ ] CHK017 Is the required behavior for unauthenticated and unauthorized access explicitly distinguished, including the intended externally visible response? [Gap, Plan Constitution Check]
- [ ] CHK018 Are patient-data minimization requirements defined for full-profile retrieval, search summaries, API errors, audit metadata, and operational logs? [Coverage, Spec §FR-010, §FR-015, Contract Common rules]
- [ ] CHK019 Are the trusted-actor and hospital-authorization dependencies specified with clear ownership and readiness criteria before endpoint enablement? [Dependency, Plan Constitution Check]
- [ ] CHK020 Are requirements defined for preventing patient data from appearing in unexpected error messages or diagnostic output? [Gap, Spec §FR-015, Plan Constraints]

## Scenario and Edge-Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK021 Are the requirements complete for duplicate mobile numbers without implying a duplicate patient identity or overwrite? [Coverage, Spec §FR-006, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK022 Are no-match, multiple-match, and cross-hospital lookup requirements sufficiently distinct and consistent? [Coverage, Spec User Story 2, Edge Cases, Contract]
- [ ] CHK023 Are concurrent profile-edit requirements explicit about preserving already saved changes, returning conflict information, and avoiding partial updates? [Coverage, Spec §FR-014, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK024 Are migration failure and rollback expectations for new patient data explicitly documented, or intentionally deferred with an owner? [Gap, Recovery]
- [ ] CHK025 Are search-size limits and behavior under a result volume beyond the requested page explicitly specified? [Gap, Non-Functional]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK026 Can each measurable success criterion be evaluated with a defined data set, audience, timing method, and pass threshold? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001–§SC-005]
- [ ] CHK027 Are the success criteria for search performance and successful retrieval aligned with the planned scoped, paginated search behavior? [Consistency, Spec §SC-002–§SC-003, Plan Technical Context]
- [ ] CHK028 Are acceptance requirements defined for audit completeness without requiring sensitive patient data in the audit record? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015, Data Model Audit Event]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `$speckit-specify` and `$speckit-clarify`.
- Add comments or findings inline.
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference.
